The most delicious beer, atmosphere, and service
Sep 2026 • Couples
We are not coming here for the first time, and it seems we have finally found a place in Da Nang where we can drink really delicious, authentic beer.

If you look at the menu, different rewards that their beer received are listed there. We even specifically went to check on the internet—and yes, it's all real, the awards are truly deserved)

The music is cool, there are lively, happy people around, the atmosphere is very pleasant. Service 10 out of 10 - everything is fast, attentive, and without unnecessary fuss.

The prices here are certainly not the lowest, but it's really worth it. Here you at least understand what you are paying for. The beer is excellent, and the food is also very tasty, by the way.

In general, if you want to really enjoy good beer, then we are going only here now. A really cool place that you really want to go back to.

Overpriced mediocre food and drink
May 2025 • Couples
Visited East West for dinner on Saturday night. Ordered truffle fries and a platter of chicken. Fries arrived straight away and the chicken about 25 minutes later. The fries were not meant as a starter, but it certainly worked out that way.......and were just bog standard fries with no evidence of truffle. The chicken platter was the worst quality chicken I have ever encountered and must have been a very old and tough bird whilst it was alive. We tried 3 different beers between us and were unimpressed with all of them. 
The bar is nicely positioned and has a lively vibe but the very high prices for the poor quality food and drink are unjustified. 
Service was also poor. Lots of staff wandering about but they clearly havent been traned in customer service. I had to catch the attention of a member of staff to order drinks, food and the final bill. Not proactive at all.
Won't be coming here again.

Good beer with a perfect view of beach and sea
Mar 2024 • Solo
I discovered the East West Brewing Co on Da Nang Beach, right next to the beach, and my German heart skipped a beat. The brewery was supposed to serve award-winning craft beers thanks to the longstanding experience of master brewer Sean Thommen, who learned to brew in the USA and Germany. That sounded good. So I strolled into the pub - the ambience was casually chic and the outdoor area with a gorgeous view of the beach and sea was perfect for chilling out. I treated myself to an East West Pale Ale, which was delicious and could really hold its own with our German beers. Good beer with a view of the sea, that's all I need.
